headline: M-PAT (PF&REIT) jumps over 20% on a 29.5% opening gap, leading today’s market action
market_take: The coverage universe showed mixed momentum. PF&REIT led with M-PAT up 20.14% (vol×2.56) while QHOP posted a -100% opening gap. FOOD was split: XBIO plunged 22.22% with a double‑digit gap, whereas KSL rallied 12.41% on strong volume and earnings releases. CONS saw SQ rise 11.76% on a price gap, but PLE fell 10% amid a volume spike. PROP and CONMAT delivered modest gains across several names.

sector_notes.note: XBIO dropped 22.22% with an -11.11% opening gap and -12.5% intraday move; KSL posted a 12.41% rise on volume ×6.6 and released Q2 earnings; AQUA rose 10% intraday, while F&D fell 11% after a -100% opening gap.

M-PAT surged 20.14% (gap +29.5%) but saw a -7.22% intraday pullback; QHOP recorded a -100% opening gap; TU-PF posted a modest +5.45% gap; CPTREIT announced a capital reduction and KPNREIT disclosed a loan agreement.

SQ advanced 11.76% on a +5.88% opening gap; PLE declined 10% with a 3.4σ volume spike and a -10% intraday move; SOLAR fell 7.14% intraday; TRITN experienced a 4.8σ volume spike; TPOLY showed a -16.67% gap but rebounded +20% intraday.
CGD and JCK posted 10% and 7.69% gains respectively; AWC rose 4.88%; ORI disclosed a high‑impact asset sale filing; STELLA reported a land sale transaction.
WIIK jumped 9.57% on volume ×7.33 and TOA rose 5.79%; GEL suffered a -33.33% opening gap.
